Dr. Rowe shows an easy exercise that can quickly relieve upper back pain

The great part about this exercise is that it's going to strengthen and lengthen the muscles in the upper back (especially around the shoulder blades) in a short amount of time. 

It can be done at home, requires no equipment, and may give upper pain relief in seconds, 

Let us know how it works for you!
